findings.rationale: internal/config TestDefaults read the repo's own .beads/config.yaml; isolated in 3ce83d0c6, verified green under plain and hostile env in review v2 and v3.

Accepted in v1 as a multi-repo short-circuit for the rename test; v2 (G1) proved that clause steers a foreign id into a create that cannot succeed and aborts the batch, so 529b6dc9a reverted it and the importer is comment-only different from the plan commit. One accepted fix produced one confirmed defect and its corrective was a removal, not a second patch; trajectory clear.

The beads repo's own export holds 22 rows with issue type 'event' from upstream Gas Town data; those are plain bd-* ids the item never touched. A type, not a name; out of the plan's scope. Recorded in the work report's Residual Risk.

Reverted in 529b6dc9a; v3 re-ran the multi-repo probe and the import completes with the foreign row skipped and the local rows created. Pre-item behaviour on this input was a hard abort, so no working behaviour is lost.
